items.title: Financial pain of outer suburbs fuelled demise of David Jones, experts say
items.summary: After 188 years, David Jones announced it would close 19 stores, most of them in Sydney's outer suburbs.

items.title: Black Friday for homeowners as rates go up
items.summary: Millions of Australians’ bills will rise from Friday, as the major banks officially pass on the Melbourne Cup Day interest rate hike to mortgage holders.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Hammered As CEO Resigns In Disgrace
items.summary: Nvidia stock received another round of downgrades and price-target cuts on Wall Street in the wake of the latest CEO revelations.

aus.headline: Banks Pass On Rate Hike
aus.body: Major banks are passing the Melbourne Cup Day rate rise on to borrowers from Friday.
aus.why: Millions of Australian home loan bills go up from today.

us.headline: Nvidia CEO Quits, Shares Slide
us.body: Nvidia stock copped more analyst downgrades and target cuts after its boss resigned.
us.why: Nvidia is a giant in the share markets that super funds hold.

biz.headline: David Jones Shuts 19 Stores
biz.body: After 188 years, David Jones plans to close 19 stores, mostly in outer Sydney.
biz.why: Shoppers and staff in outer Sydney lose their local department store.
